name: How does Frasheski Construction help coordinate the remodel scope with various trades?

mainEntity.name: How does Frasheski Construction help coordinate the remodel scope with various trades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction coordinates the remodel scope by acting as the central point of contact for all trades involved. We develop a comprehensive project schedule and detailed specifications that clearly outline each trade's responsibilities and deliverables. Regular site meetings and clear communication channels ensure that everyone is working from the same plan, minimizing misunderstandings and ensuring seamless transitions between different phases of work. This streamlined approach keeps the project on track and within scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: We coordinate scope by being the central contact for all trades, using a detailed schedule and specifications, and ensuring clear communication to keep the project on track.
